evidence_spans: Across nine benchmarks, measured ARM2GC-to-RV2GC runtime ratios range from 12.81 to 4,043.
CLM-ARCH-0171.statement: RV2GC achieves an online execution speedup over ARM2GC of 4,042.58x on the SHA3-256 workload.

RV2GC and ARM2GC share the underlying garbling implementation and use 128-bit wire labels.
